GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased from its wide barrier in the early stages to obtain cover and settled towards the rear. Held up for clear running from the 400m until passing the 300m. When questioned regarding the tactics adopted. RR instructed to ride in a forward position if it was to begin well, however if it was to begin on terms to attempt to obtain a position with cover. Slow to muster speed in the early stages despite his efforts and although he was able to obtain a position with cover, settled further back than intended. Hindsight he may have been able to place his mount under pressure sooner than he did..

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Pushed along Two Wide (1/2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened on inside in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR instructed to ride the gelding positively from the inside barrier and after only being fair to begin, she rode her mount along to hold her position. Added passing the 1200m she contemplated allowing runners to her outside to cross, however elected to maintain her position and hold the lead which was further forward than she intended.
